jobs.name: work-sparql
rules:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
CONSTRUCT { ?person ex:worksInCountry ?country } WHERE { ?person ex:worksFor ?company . ?company ex:locatedIn ?country }

PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
CONSTRUCT { ?person ex:worksOnContinent ?continent } WHERE { ?person ex:worksInCountry ?country . ?country ex:onContinent ?continent }

jobs.name: totals
rules:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
CONSTRUCT { ?line ex:total ?total } WHERE { ?line ex:unitPrice ?price ; ex:quantity ?quantity . BIND(?price * ?quantity AS ?total) FILTER(?total > 10) }

jobs.name: portfolio-risk

inputs.name: portfolio

rules:
PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX ex: <https://claims.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX fin: <https://finance.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
CONSTRUCT { ?policy rsk:atRisk true } WHERE { ?claim ex:onPolicy ?policy ; ex:severity "high" }

PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX ex: <https://claims.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX fin: <https://finance.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
CONSTRUCT { ?policy rsk:highSeverityClaims ?count } WHERE { SELECT ?policy (COUNT(?claim) AS ?count) WHERE { ?claim ex:onPolicy ?policy ; ex:severity "high" } GROUP BY ?policy }

PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX ex: <https://claims.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX fin: <https://finance.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
CONSTRUCT { ?policy rsk:riskNote ?note } WHERE { ?claim ex:onPolicy ?policy ; ex:severity "high" ; ex:narrative ?text . ?policy ins:policyNumber ?n ; fin:costCentre ?cc ; fin:budgetOwner ?owner . BIND(CONCAT("Policy ", ?n, " owned by ", ?owner, " (", ?cc, ") has a high-severity claim: ", ?text) AS ?note) }

jobs.name: reserved-claims
rules:
PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
# Needs stage 1: the LossReserve type is a deduction of the OWL-RL job `acme`, not stored data.
CONSTRUCT { ?claim rsk:hasReserve ?amount } WHERE { ?claim ins:hasLossReserve ?amount . ?amount a ins:LossReserve }

jobs.name: reserve-summary
rules:
PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
# Needs stage 2: rsk:hasReserve exists only in the output of `reserved-claims`.
CONSTRUCT { ?policy rsk:reservedClaims ?count } WHERE { SELECT ?policy (COUNT(DISTINCT ?claim) AS ?count) WHERE { ?claim rsk:hasReserve ?amount ; ins:against ?detail . ?detail ins:hasPolicy ?policy } GROUP BY ?policy }
